Gliding Ice Track.name: Gliding Ice Track
Gliding Ice Track.description: The user lays a narrow ice track from their right side and slides up to fifteen meters along it this turn, raising a low ramp to cross a shallow gap. The track remains slippery until melted or broken. The user needs a continuous surface to build from and enough space to brake; sharp turns or carrying an unsecured passenger risks a fall. Strain: moderate.
